say:3:1610505001:0.text: Like everyone else, you bow deeply to the lively young princess.

say:5:1610505002:2.text: She doesn't greet you as she passes, but as you rise from your bow, she glances your way and gives a discreet wink. Looks like Rowan's message got through.

say:6:1610505003:2.text: Princess Peggy stops before a portrait, clearly taken by it. You and the others fall in behind and watch as she admires the paintings.
say:6:1610505003:2.source_cn: 佩吉公主停在了一张画像前面，她似乎突然对这里的艺术品产...

say:7:1610505004:0.text: The composition and brushwork suggest Lady Sharron's style—the famous pastoral painter.
say:7:1610505004:0.source_cn: 这张油画有着完美的构图、大胆的配色以及粗犷但奇妙的笔触...

say:9:1610505005:1.text: You have a sharp eye, Your Highness. It is Lady Sharron's work. It was never exhibited in public; her son donated it to the Serene Lyceum after her passing.
say:9:1610505005:1.source_cn: 您的眼光很准，这的确是雪伦女士的作品。这幅画从未在市面...

say:10:1610505006:0.text: Gervan, you really live up to your family name! You're refined, humble, and clearly well-read.
say:10:1610505006:0.source_cn: 格墨文，你不愧是嘉德侯爵的后裔，优雅、谦虚而且非常博学。

say:11:1610505007:1.text: Thank you, Your Highness. But everyone here is just as knowledgeable.
say:11:1610505007:1.source_cn: 感谢您的夸奖，公主殿下。实际上，我周围的每一位同伴都是...

say:12:1610505008:1.text: Now I see why the Serene Lyceum is Esperia's most prestigious magic academy. You are precisely the talents the royal court needs!
say:12:1610505008:1.source_cn: 真不愧是莱希拉姆，最出名的魔法学校！真希望宫廷中能多一...
say:12:1610505008:1.male: Now I see why the Serene Lyceum is Esperia's most prestigious magic academy. You are precisely the talents the royal court needs!
say:12:1610505008:1.female: Now I see why the Serene Lyceum is Esperia's most prestigious magic academy. You are precisely the talents the royal court needs!

say:13:1610505009:1.text: Of course, that's all up to Cyran. As for me, I'm here to enjoy the Lyceum's art collection. I'm truly eager to see the finest of the fine.
say:13:1610505009:1.source_cn: 当然啦，这些都是迪尔格雷要操心的事情。我呢，今天是来参...

say:14:1610505010:1.text: I rarely travel outside of Savannah. I intend to savor every moment I spend here.
say:14:1610505010:1.source_cn: 好不容易离开赛凡纳一趟，我一定要在这里好好看个够。

say:15:1610505011:1.text: It won't be any fun touring this place by myself. Come with me! Perhaps one of you can describe the paintings as we walk?
say:15:1610505011:1.source_cn: 不过一个人参观太没意思了，你们陪我一起吧，还能为我讲解...
